claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Nitecore NL188 3100mAh 2C as a 3100mAh preset with a 2C runtime rating.
The Nitecore NL188 is listed as an 18650 protected battery with approximately 70 mm total length and 18.7 mm diameter.
Nitecore NL188 is identified as a protected rechargeable lithium-ion cell, but its exact cathode chemistry was not established.
The exact catalog entry Nitecore NL188 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2013-11-09 or earlier.
